summary: Iteration 10 (welcome screen, scratch date, vertical timeline, event art). Backend: the new test_iteration10_welcome_timeline.py has 7 tests. The full suite passed 165/165. welcome_text and timeline_art persist on POST/PUT/GET and in the public endpoint. The defaults are '' and true. 401 characters and a non-bool timeline_art give 422. Frontend at 412x860 on demo-shahnawaz-farah: intro skip goes to the welcome screen (Welcome, Ali Khan, the default note, Open the invitation) and then the cover. Replay shows intro, then welcome, then cover again. Direct /e4 goes intro, welcome, then the Walima page. Scratching with the mouse reveals the date (is-revealed set, page scrollTop unchanged), and the date is Wednesday, 9 December 2026. The reveal button also works, and the card is hidden again after reload. The timeline has e1..e4 in order, alternating left/right, with the right art kinds (haldi/baraat/nikah/walima) and Next up on e1, with no horizontal overflow. A tap opens /e3?to=Ali+Khan. The event page has event-page-art (nikah), no card-blessing, prev reading 'Previous event', and next/prev nav. Back-all returns to the cover at the same scroll (994 before and after). The wishes link scrolls to the wishes section. No page errors. NOT TESTED (ran out of time): the Concluded tag with a past event, the 340px single-column layout, the second-script name (faraz has only one event, named in Urdu, so it has no timeline; the test needs an Urdu/Hindi card with Latin event names), the zara single-event scratch card, the wizard timeline-art switch and welcome text input, and the regression checks (effects, 1440 column, landing/Watch intro).

ui_bugs.issue: The scratch card is only about 120px wide, not up to 320px. The date shows clipped as 'WEDNESD / 9 DECEME / 2026', and the canvas hint 'Scratch to reveal the date' is cut off. RCA: .gc-section has margin:0 auto inside the flex-column .gc-hub-page/.gc-view-inner. Auto margins stop the flex item from stretching, so the section shrinks to the width of the 'Save the date' eyebrow (165px), and .gc-scratch width:100% follows it. Fix: add width:100% (or align-self:stretch) to the scratch section, e.g. give it a class .gc-scratch-section {width:100%}. This probably affects SinglePage too.

issues: en_more.js guest has 'concluded' twice: 'This event has concluded' on line 70 and 'Concluded' on line 75. The later one wins, so CountdownSection (CardSections.jsx:118) now shows only 'Concluded'. Use a separate key such as concludedTag for the timeline tag. Check the hi/ur files for the same problem.

action_items: Fix the scratch card width (it is clipped at about 120px) by making the scratch section full width
Split the duplicate guest.concluded i18n key so the countdown keeps 'This event has concluded'
